#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;

    if (s.empty()) {
        return 0;
    }

    cout << s[0];
    size_t pos = 1;
    bool at_used = false;

    while (pos < s.size()) {
        size_t dot = s.find("dot", pos);
        size_t at = s.find("at", pos);

        size_t nxt;
        if (dot != string::npos && at != string::npos) {
            nxt = (dot < at) ? dot : at;
        } else if (dot != string::npos) {
            nxt = dot;
        } else if (at != string::npos) {
            nxt = at;
        } else {
            cout << s.substr(pos);
            break;
        }

        cout << s.substr(pos, nxt - pos);
        size_t remaining = s.size() - nxt;

        if (nxt == dot && remaining >= 3 &&
            s.compare(nxt, 3, "dot") == 0 && remaining != 3) {
            cout << '.';
            pos = nxt + 3;
        } else if (!at_used && nxt == at && remaining >= 2 &&
                   s.compare(nxt, 2, "at") == 0 && remaining != 2) {
            cout << '@';
            at_used = true;
            pos = nxt + 2;
        } else {
            cout << s[nxt];
            pos = nxt + 1;
        }
    }

    return 0;
